paras: Mr. de Souza, here is everything for tomorrow and the day after, in one page.
ARRIVAL. Your flight arrives at six fifteen in the evening. A driver waits for you after you leave the bags area, with your name on a sign. If you do not find him, call the hotel and we call him.
THE HOTEL. Room 512, on the fifth floor. There are two elevators next to the front desk, and breakfast is from seven to ten on the first floor.

DINNER. The Blue Door, on Market Street, two streets from the hotel. Turn left at the entrance and walk straight. It is on the corner, opposite the bank. Dinner is at eight, and please be early, because the kitchen closes at ten thirty.
THE NEXT MORNING. The car is at the door at seven thirty in the morning, not at eight. The first meeting is at nine and it finishes at eleven. In the afternoon there is nothing until five.
One last thing. The shops on Market Street take only cash, so change some money at the airport, and always ask for the receipt.

listenings.text: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen, and welcome. The local time is six fifteen in the evening and the weather outside is cold, about seven degrees, with some rain. Please stay in your seat until we stop completely. Two things before you leave the aircraft. First, if this is your final destination, follow the blue signs after passport control, and your bags are on belt number four. Second, if you have a connection tonight, do not follow the blue signs. Go to the transfer desk on your right, and please go quickly, because the last flights of the evening leave in about fifty minutes. Thank you for flying with us, and have a very good evening.

Hey. So, you asked me how it went, and honestly, better than I thought. I landed at six fifteen, I found the driver, and I talked to him in the car for twenty minutes. Twenty minutes, in English, alone. Not perfect, I lost him three or four times and I asked him to repeat, and it was fine. The hotel was easy: I have a reservation, room five twelve, fifth floor, and I said the number back to be sure. At dinner I ordered for myself, the fish, and there was a woman at the next table who started talking, and I did not go quiet. I asked her where she was from. That is the part I want to tell you about. Not the words. The part where I did not go quiet.

extra_audio.text: Good evening. I have a reservation, my name is Leao de Souza. Room five twelve, fifth floor. What time is breakfast? And where is the Blue Door restaurant? Thank you very much.
